content.kicker: the barrier talk nobody gave you

hook.body: Most sensitive skin is not sensitive. It is a barrier stripped by a routine doing too much, too often. The fix is almost always subtraction.

ranked.name: Too many actives
lines: Acid on Monday, retinoid on Tuesday, vitamin C on Wednesday. Each is fine alone. Stacked, they never let the barrier finish repairing.
ranked.note: Try one active, three nights a week, for a month before adding anything.

ranked.name: Water that is too hot
lines: Hot water strips the lipids that hold moisture in. The tightness afterwards is not clean, it is damage you can feel.
ranked.note: Lukewarm, and pat dry rather than rub.

ranked.name: Skipping moisturiser
lines: Oily skin that is stripped produces more oil, not less. The shine people fight is often the barrier trying to rebuild itself.
ranked.note: A light gel moisturiser is still a moisturiser.

points: Cleanser, moisturiser, SPF. That is the whole routine.
Add one active back, three nights a week.
Give any change a month before deciding.
